
{{alias}}( x, ndims )
    Returns an object containing methods for reshaping an ndarray as an
    n-dimensional strided array view.

    If unable to resolve a reshape strategy (e.g., when reshaping would require
    merging non-singleton dimensions and more than one dimension is desired),
    the function returns `null`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: Object
        Descriptor.

    ndims: integer
        Number of dimensions of the desired strided array view.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object|null
        Object containing an input and output strategy.

    out.input: Function
        Function providing a strategy for reshaping an input ndarray to an
        n-dimensional input ndarray view prior to applying an n-dimensional
        strided array function.

    out.output: Function
        Function providing a strategy for reshaping the results of an
        n-dimensional strided array function to the shape of an input ndarray
        after applying an n-dimensional strided array function. This function
        should only be invoked for input ndarrays which are written to by the
        n-dimensional strided array function.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {
    ...   'dtype': 'float64',
    ...   'data': new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ] ),
    ...   'shape': [ 1 ],
    ...   'strides': [ 1 ],
    ...   'offset': 0,
    ...   'order': 'row-major'
    ... };
    > var o = {{alias}}( x, 1 )
    {...}

    See Also
    --------
